en-US.longDescription:
Skrooge is a personal finance manager powered by KDE that aims to be simple and intuitive. Skrooge allows you to keep track of your expenses and income, categorize them, and build reports of them.
Features:
- QIF, CSV, SKROOGE, KMYMONEY import/export
- Microsoft Money, OFX, QFX, MT940, GNUCASH, GRISBI, HOMEBANK and MONEY MANAGER EX import
- Advanced Graphical Reports
- Multiple tabs to help you organize your work
- Infinite undo/redo (even after the file was closed !)
- Instant filtering on transactions and reports
- Infinite category levels
- Mass update of transactions
- Scheduled transactions
- Track refund of your expenses
- Automatically process transactions based on search conditions
- Multiple currencies
- Budget
- Dashboard
- Advice
en-US.name: Skrooge

zh-CN.longDescription:
Skrooge 是一款由 KDE 提供支持的个人理财管理软件，旨在简单直观。Skrooge 可帮助您记录支出和收入，对它们进行分类，并生成相应的报表。
功能：
- 支持 QIF、CSV、SKROOGE、KMYMONEY 的导入/导出
- 支持导入 Microsoft Money、OFX、QFX、MT940、GNUCASH、GRISBI、HOMEBANK 和 MONEY MANAGER EX
- 高级图形报表
- 多标签页，便于组织工作
- 无限次撤销/重做（即使文件已关闭！）
- 对交易和报表进行即时筛选
- 无限层级的分类
- 交易批量更新
- 定期交易
- 追踪支出退款
- 基于搜索条件自动处理交易
- 支持多种货币
- 预算管理
- 仪表盘
- 理财建议
